prompt: A rain-soaked iron fire escape five floors up a brick tenement during a police chase, late 1920s, widescreen. Seen from just beyond the railing at eye level on an 85mm lens, a heavyset man near seventy, clean-shaven, jowls running with rain, soaked black homburg, fills the frame from chest to crown, facing almost front and glancing down past us. His right arm is flung wide with a revolver aimed at the sky, far from his face. The window beside him is mid-burst, glass hanging in the air. Far below, an unlettered theatre marquee of icy white bulbs burns out of focus, while magenta light from a sign across the alley washes his face and mouth. Backlit rain falls in white threads; wet iron slats and the window shards shine magenta and white. Everything outside the lamps is black. Thanks.
